issue_title: [Bug] _ensure_parent_directory 检查所有 parents 但 exist_ok=False 可能在竞态条件下失败
fix_summary: Changed mkdir() from exist_ok=False to exist_ok=True to handle TOCTOU race condition where another process might create the directory between the exists() check and mkdir() call.
risks_limitations: Minimal risk - the change makes the code more resilient to race conditions. The directory validation logic (checking parents for file-as-directory confusion) remains intact.
